GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went through on fence to lead. led turn going well. kicked well clear early in Straight . tired late # fell in
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Wide 1 length. 3 Wide turn under pressure. dropped out # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked to lead. led turn going well. looked winner # grabbed last stride
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics: To be ridden further forward; led.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back rail 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly resulting in its rider being unbalanced. Passing the 600m when pulling hard, was checked from heels but ultimately clipped the heels of that runner abd blundered.  Near the 200m was disappointed for a run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. battled away # Not Sighted
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. ran on well in Straight . # start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was badly crowded on jumping by rnr which shifted in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. 4th turn 4 lengths. just battled in Straight # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When qstd, rdr stated he was instructed settle near the rear of the field. He added that after beginning well, rather than restraining his mnt or risking racing three-wide, he elected to settle mid with cover. He added that near 700m when he became aware the rnr he was trailing was commencing to weaken, he shifted to the inside of that rnr to avoid covering additional ground. However, when this rnr now also failed to improve, he became held up. He added in hindsight, and whilst mindful that the turn can be difficult to negotiate, it may have been more advantageous to shift to the outside.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (6L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside midrace & pushed to quicken @ 450m. Pushed along on inside @ 400m & chasing on rail (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & ran on soundly Two Wide in last 150m. # Good from rear.
Jumped Ok eased from barrier to last 10 lengths. last turn. hooked Wide 300 metres. ran on strongly # good from barrier
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside turn, just battled in Straight # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 4 lengths. hooked Wide turn 2 lengths. ran on well, # just did enough
